description: List the account's AI works (subtitles, translations, dubbing, lipsync, eBook=ABSTRACT, mind map=MINDMAP, quiz=QUESTIONS) page by page, newest first, with status (QUEUE, RUNNING, FINISHED, ERROR, SKIPPED). Only the latest attempt of each video × type × language. Filters: status, updated_since, video_id, folder_id (the API doesn't filter by type). Read-only. Returns {works: [{id, video_id, type, status, from_lang, to_lang, credits_charged, created_at, updated_at}], page, pages, total}.

updated_since.description: Only works updated since this ISO date/time, e.g. '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
